hooks.command: bash -c 'd="${GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}}"; while [ ! -x "$d/.agents/hooks/pre-tool-guard.sh" ] && [ "$d" != / ] && [ "$d" != . ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; [ -x "$d/.agents/hooks/pre-tool-guard.sh" ] && exec "$d/.agents/hooks/pre-tool-guard.sh"; echo "pre-tool-guard.sh 를 찾지 못해 명령을 막습니다(.agents/hooks 확인)" >&2; exit 2'

bash -c 'd="${GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}}"; while [ ! -x "$d/.agents/hooks/stop-check.sh" ] && [ "$d" != / ] && [ "$d" != . ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; [ -x "$d/.agents/hooks/stop-check.sh" ] && exec "$d/.agents/hooks/stop-check.sh"; echo "stop-check.sh 를 찾지 못해 종료 검사를 건너뜁니다" >&2; echo "{}"; exit 0'
